analysis_unit: one home by one retrofit event

PM25_eligibility.statistic: mean of untransformed valid pre-period daily means
PM25_eligibility.status: fixed after exploratory analyses; not prospectively prespecified

SI_sensitivity.comparison_pool: original coverage-eligible comparisons without baseline concentration restriction

comparison_pool: never treated, excluding Homes 4 and 17 for recorded works
adjustment: heating season (November-March) when both categories are present
covariance: home random intercept plus AR(1) using actual calendar-day gaps
interval: approximate model-conditional 95% t(G-2), one treated home per event
questionnaire_inputs: Descriptive Tables 1/S4 only; not model covariates
log1p_sensitivity: Same primary model rows and design; change y only; eligibility on original-scale baseline
placebo: 56 primary fits plus Home 14 CWI CITS with the expanded comparison pool; fixed participating homes
